info.name: School Management API
info.description:
Complete collection for the School Management API. Covers adding schools and listing them sorted by proximity.

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}`  
Set the `base_url` variable to your deployed host, e.g. `http://localhost:3000`

request.description: Returns API status, version, and available endpoints.
Ping the API for liveness checks.

Add a new school. All four fields are required.

**Required fields:**
- `name` (string, 2–255 chars)
- `address` (string, 5–500 chars)
- `latitude` (float, -90 to 90)
- `longitude` (float, -180 to 180)

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Demonstrates validation — empty name and invalid latitude.

response.name: 422 Unprocessable Entity

request.description: Re-sending the same school returns a 409 Conflict.

response.name: 409 Conflict

request.description: Returns all schools sorted by distance (nearest first) from the provided user coordinates. Distance is calculated using the Haversine formula and expressed in kilometres.

response.name: 200 OK
